slot.brief: Identify reagents to convert aniline to a target (e.g. benzene via diazonium, or iodobenzene) in correct order.

stem: Which sequence of reagents converts aniline into fluorobenzene?

verdicts.working: Diazotize aniline, then treat the diazonium salt with HBF₄ and heat (Balz–Schiemann reaction) to form fluorobenzene.

working:
$\text{C}_6\text{H}_5\text{NH}_2 \xrightarrow[273\text{–}278\ \text{K}]{\text{NaNO}_2/\text{HCl}} \text{C}_6\text{H}_5\text{N}_2^+\text{Cl}^-$
$\text{HBF}_4$ gives the diazonium tetrafluoroborate.
Heating it replaces $-\text{N}_2^+$ with $-\text{F}$, yielding fluorobenzene.
